chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
“Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام, when he prayed, would not conclude until he placed his right cheek on the ground and his left cheek on the ground.”

key_terms.لَمْ يَنْفَتِلْ: he did not turn away or conclude immediately
key_terms.يُلْصِقَ: to press or place closely against

ai.seo_question: What did Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام do after salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام after salat (prayer), showing an act of humility and devotion by placing both cheeks upon the ground. In the chapter context, it relates to the practice of sajdah of gratitude and reflects a prophetic model of worship.
